page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores with a base frequency of 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 310.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 6.46 GB of RAM per core. Graphics and parallel computing acceleration are delivered via a single NVIDIA A10 GPU based on the Ampere architecture, which includes 24 GB of dedicated VRAM.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The hypervisor layer is managed via KVM. The lack of local NVMe or SSD storage represents a key architectural tradeoff, requiring external storage configurations for persistent data.

Benchmark results indicate strong capabilities in specific workloads. The instance achieves top-tier performance in LLM inference, processing 9711.08 tokens per second for a small 135M model prompt and 2509.43 tokens per second for a medium 7B model prompt. Text generation speeds reach 456.51 tokens per second on the 135M model and 90.44 tokens per second on the 7B model. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and PassMark CPU encryption tests also rank in the top 25% tier. Most general CPU, memory, and database benchmarks, such as Redis SET operations at 43.93 million operations per second, fall within the average performance tier.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of a dedicated 48-core Intel Xeon CPU and an enterprise-grade NVIDIA A10 GPU offers a balanced resource density for parallel computing without the premium cost of multi-GPU configurations. This server is suited for workloads such as low-to-medium parameter LLM inference, image processing, cryptography, and multi-threaded data decompression tasks.
